Trading Status: **{{#38761D}}Open for all trade!{{/color}}**
Browse or search, pick the recordings you're interested in, copy them and contact  me for trade!
Rules:
**Links:**
My links will be **MEGA** links, and will stay active for **5+** days. If you need more time, please let me know in advance or send me a message. Please do not reuse my links!

I prefer MEGA links (especially for videos) , but im fine with other platforms such as Google Drive, Dropbox or MediaFire. Do not send me YouTube links or links to other streaming platforms. 

I strictly follow **{{#FF0000}}NFT{{/color}}** rules and respect NFT dates.
Don’t ask me for NFT items

**Standard Trade Ratios:**
Video : Video — 1:1
Audio : Audio — 1:1
Audio : Video — 2:1 ; Video : Audio — 1:2

These ratios do not excludes limited trade items.
These ratios aren't set in stone, I'm willing to make an uneven trade for special circumstances, or to trade several highlights for one recording.

No "this for that" trades, so please send me your full list!

Whoever initiates the trade sends their links first.

READ ME:
Hi! I'm gzylz, or you can call me Alexia!

I don't have Encora yet. I'm happy to build trust through trading over time, but please don't send me only your Encora list, as I won't be able to access it!

I can't be 100% certain that none of my files are rips. Please check the file types and sizes listed. I've added My Notes to entries where I'm particularly unsure about the info, which I hope will help!

The audio file types and sizes listed are based on the files I have, as displayed on MEGA or Windows. They're provided for reference.

If you notice any errors in my list, please let me know! I'll correct or remove them as soon as possible. Thank you so much!

Dates are formatted as Year-Month-Day (YYYY-MM-DD).
Dates without a specific day are formatted as Year-Month (YYYY-MM)

I'm happy to trade any number of items!

For audio trades, if you have a preferred way of receiving the files, please let me know in advance!
(individual links for each file / one link containing all the files / a separate folder for each show / one link per show, etc.)

Please let me know if anything I write is unclear or comes across as impolite! I'll do my best to express what I really mean. Sorry for my poor English and awkward phrasing ><
